decisions.reason: Mobile PDF signing still fits the firm's push into app-based signing and digital contracts, but by 2022 it is more likely to be folded into a broader platform feature than marketed as a standalone product.
A multi-layer end-to-end security architecture remains highly core to the firm's cryptography-led identity and mobile security platform and is therefore unlikely to be withdrawn.
As a narrow delivery tool in a broader secure-communication portfolio, this offer is the most likely to be absorbed into integrated messaging services and no longer justified as a separate product.

The payment security compliance suite still serves regulated enterprise demand and leverages the firm's established authentication infrastructure, even if its niche positioning raises some medium-term rationalization risk.
